name: bellteam-lattice-module
description: Child-only dependencies of the lattice module payload; Owner 2026-11-14: always the latest Lattice, no exact pin (the lock records the resolved version) (docs/architecture/modules/runtime/lattice-child.md). @quolu/lattice 0.85.5 is the minimum: the first release with todo display read/source. 0.86.0 adds todo add (one task) for seats; 0.86.1 stops witness prompts on conversation plans; 0.87.0 adds todo independence witness declare (one task's row); 0.88.0 refuses a missing or blank design_memo (DESIGN_MEMO_REQUIRED) and adds opt-in enforced plans; 0.89.0 reports a value written by a newer Lattice as UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA (newer_lattice_value) instead of STORE_CORRUPT and adds --message to done hints on enforced plans; 0.90.0 lets witness declare record a row on a Store root with no commit (the chart dirs are git init without a commit), so enforced plans can start there, and adds startable notices (mutation result notices, todo notice list|ack); 0.91.0 accepts or rejects a phase with --message (evidence as text, no file in the Store root), so heavy phases of enforced plans can close on chart dirs without a commit; 0.92.0 adds todo wait (waiting marks on notices: waiting, waiting_digest, acked_recipients; ack set v2, v1 still reads), so the module can wake the Bots waiting on a task; 0.93.0 anchors evidence blobs under refs/lattice/evidence/<oid> so git gc keeps them (todo evidence anchor for evidence written before); 0.94.0 answers STORE_UNINITIALIZED (todo evidence anchor: exit 0, lattice.todo_evidence_anchor_uninitialized.v1) on a chart dir with no Store instead of STORE_INCONSISTENT; 0.95.0 adds todo nudge (read-only ready set per lane with fire/stop actions and a prompt) and answers STORE_UNINITIALIZED on the display reads too (display source exits 0 with project_id null); 0.96.0 adds todo blockers (read-only list of every stop on a chart); 0.97.0 lets any seat retract an in-progress task and reopen a done one (a journal with a reopen is unreadable to older Lattice: never downgrade below 0.97.0); 0.97.1 keeps a stop's time and actor in todo blockers across a plan revise (same shape); 0.98.0 removes todo nudge (unknown command; the module never calls it, its sweep reads the memo projections); 0.99.0 lets a task wait on a task of another chart (todo dependency connect --from-project, read only from LATTICE_CHARTS_ROOT, which every run sets; display read adds external_tasks); 0.100.0 adds `trees` to todo display read (a100), keeps incoming ledger edges across a revision (edge carry), and speeds revisions on large plans (validated-version memo, one-pass rebind of in-progress tasks; outage 2026-11-14); 0.101.0 adds the host connection contract (charts list/source, chart set, chart repo bind/sync, LATTICE_PROJECT_ID addressing; a101/a102); 0.102.0 makes setup exit 0 on partial (the module never calls setup); 0.102.1 cuts a task's note context at 512 entries (bellteam-dev-added has more than 512 plan notes, so note list/show/start note_context failed NOTE_PROJECTION_INVALID on every task; a150); 0.103.0 seals the plan-scoped journal at 1 MiB and continues in a new segment (bellteam-dev-added reached the cap: every write was refused plan_scoped_journal_segment_limit_exceeded; a154) and keeps task note context cut at 512 (#189); 0.104.0 lifts the 512-task cap of a plan (bellteam-dev-added refused todo add), adds the 接続 commands (todo predecessor add|remove, todo connect condition add|remove|resolve, todo connect priority; todo wait and dependency connect|disconnect stay aliases that print lattice.todo_command_retired.v1 on stderr after success) and moves status and session-context to lattice.todo_status_result.v10 (connections in status, session-context, todo show and todo display read). 0.105.0 keeps only a reverse patch for a superseded plan version and adds todo compact (lattice.todo_compact_result.v1); a compacted chart is unreadable to a child older than 0.105.0, so todo compact runs only after the 0.105.0 child is live. 0.106.0 stops verifying evidence and history on reads and writes (ADR 0203; todo verify runs only when asked), records done as plain text (task evidence {message}; legacy records stay readable) and keeps evidence_unverified in the v10 shapes, always false; a 0.105 reader refuses the new done/accept/reject shapes, so the 0.106.0 child must be live before a seat writes them. 0.107.0 adds `chart set --no-code-lane` (the module sets approval-box on the bellteam code chart; a chart carrying that key is unreadable to a child older than 0.107.0, so never roll the child back below 0.107.0), fetches depth 1 only on the first chart repo sync, excludes .lattice/sensor/ in sensor init|sync (g2) and drops the enforced done-reference gate. 0.108.0 keeps declared tasks' independence records across a plan revision, drops INDEPENDENCE_READY_UNDECLARED, writes the record above 8 declared tasks (wave_plan null) and judges a clean code chart through its maintained index. 0.109.0 adds function-level declarations (code graph stage A, ADR 0204): `todo add|witness declare --owns|--reads path#function` and plan create/revise `tasks[].touches` (--schema-version 6) record the functions a task changes, Lattice judges that task against every unfinished task by function and records the overlaps itself (the add is never refused; the result carries `declaration`), the Store gains `.lattice/todo/relations/<plan>/`, and new read fields appear (`todo start` advisory.relations, `todo show` relations, `session-context` independence[].function_conflicts; `status --json` is unchanged). A plan that writes `path#function` in `--reads` gets witness set v6, which a seat older than 0.109.0 cannot read, so every seat on the shared Store (and the code chart host) is on 0.109.0 before members write functions. 0.110.0 adds function split (stage B, ADR 0205): a function two lanes both write is split at the second task start, `todo function-split verify|decline` (the seat tool passes todo through), and the first split promotes that plan to `lattice.todo_plan.v9`, which a seat older than 0.110.0 cannot read (UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA), so the child and every seat bin are on 0.110.x together before any split is written. 0.110.1 speeds the Store (#234 reads stop re-verifying every retained version, #235 sensor affected queries run concurrently; production copy: todo note 4.4 -> 2.0 s, status 1.9 -> 0.9 s, todo add 20.5 -> 6.5-7.4 s). 0.110.2 validates the same Store bytes once per command (#237; todo add about 5.7 -> 4.3 s on the production copy; no host change). 0.111.0 lets a witness row carry `new_symbols` and a relation entry a function name with no lines (a name not on main is kept as a new function; `declaration.new_names` shows near names, `declaration.whole_files` counts what a whole-file claim conflicts with), so a seat older than 0.111.0 cannot read that plan: the child and every seat bin move to 0.111.0 in one train before anyone declares a function that is not on main. 0.111.1 only adds text: each `declaration.new_names` entry has `text`, and a `todo add` with `declaration.written: false` carries `declaration.next_action` (no host change). 0.111.3 (0.111.2 skipped) lets lattice-mcp start read-only in a project folder that refuses writes (an ask_readonly fork) instead of failing with LATTICE.MCP_SERVER_FAILED, and sets picomatch noextglob (CVE-2026-112366); 0.111.4 also opens a write-banned code-graph index reached through projectPath read-only (0.111.3 still failed with "attempt to write a readonly database" there); 0.111.5 removes picomatch from the dependencies (CVE-2026-112366; the one Cargo-workspace glob call uses an own matcher); no host change. 0.112.0 adds `todo display read --json --compact` (lattice.todo_display_compact_result.v1: journal and plan_scoped replaced by activity and cross_plan_dependencies; the full read of bellteam was 17.5 MB and grows with the journal; a456), which the module reads from here on. 0.113.1 lets a revision genesis fill a segment alone up to 8 MiB (0.113.0 and older answer STORE_CORRUPT journal_segment_limit_exceeded on the stopped bellteam store; no host change, but every CLI that reads bellteam must be on 0.113.1). 0.113.2 (Ludmila #259, m1) stops a read from opening every retained revision of a plan (the coordination declaration is carried into each new revision; production copy: session-context 454 -> 234 MB, display read --compact 563 -> 354 MB; no format change, no host change).
